sources.entry: Franz - Franz is messaging application for services like WhatsApp, Slack, Messenger and many more.

summary.one_liner: Franz is a desktop messaging app that combines many chat and email services (WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, Discord, etc.) into one window; this repo holds Franz 5, the open-source predecessor, which the README says is no longer the active product.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Franz 5 as a messaging app for services such as WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, HipChat and Hangouts, with the source published under Apache-2.0 for reference and self-building. It is built on Electron and uses lerna to bootstrap a multi-package monorepo, with npm scripts for development, rebuilding native modules and packaging. Services are supported through plugins/recipes, which the README says are documented in a separate Plugins repository. The README also points to a Homebrew cask for macOS downloads. The top of the README promotes Franz 6, a newer closed product on meetfranz.com with features like Franz Mail, Franz Assistant and Privacy Shield; those are not part of this repository's code.
use_cases: combine multiple chat accounts in one app
run WhatsApp, Slack and Telegram in a single window
self-build an open-source multi-messenger desktop client
study an Electron messaging app codebase
write custom service recipes for a messaging aggregator
notable: Aggregates many chat services into one desktop window
Plugin/recipe system for adding new services, documented in a separate repo
caveats: README states this is Franz 5, no longer the active product; the current app is Franz 6 at meetfranz.com
Development database is reset regularly, per the README
Development setup requires Linux OS dependencies and rebuilding native modules
